name: Drumming Woodpecker
text: Peck 2. Whenever this attacks, give your other Birds +1 Attack this combat.
golden_text: Peck 2. Whenever this attacks, give your other Birds +2 Attack this combat.

source.note: Peck (X): its attack strikes the target X times, Attack split as evenly as possible (larger parts first). Each strike fires this unit's 'whenever this attacks'. The target hits back once, with the last strike.
